objects.name: Detection technique coverage: github-enterprise-repository-archived
objects.description: The following analytic detects when a repository is archived in GitHub Enterprise. The detection monitors GitHub Enterprise audit logs for repository archival events by tracking actor details, repository information, and associated metadata. For a SOC, identifying repository archival is important as it could indicate attempts to make critical code inaccessible or preparation for repository deletion.
